%200.1%20y%20sin%20warmup%3B%20el%20ViT%20con%20warmup%20no%20lo%20necesit%C3%B3%20a%2011.6%25%20de%20los%20pesos%20y%20solo%20lo%20aprovech%C3%B3%20por%20debajo%20de%20~8%25.%20%C2%BFEl%20factor%20es%20la%20arquitectura%20o%20la%20estabilidad%20del%20arranque%20del%20optimizador%3F%20*(Repetir%20la%20ResNet%20con%20warmup%20y%20el%20ViT%20sin%20%C3%A9l.)*%0A%20%20%20%202.%20En%20el%20ViT%20largo%20el%20rewinding%20no%20ayud%C3%B3%20con%20poco%20podado%20pero%20s%C3%AD%20con%20mucho.%20%C2%BFEl%20punto%20de%20rewind%20necesario%20depende%20del%20nivel%20de%20poda%2C%20no%20solo%20de%20la%20arquitectura%3F%20*(Barrido%20de%20%24k%24%20a%20dos%20o%20tres%20sparsidades%20fijas.)*%0A%20%20%20%203.%20%C2%BFEs%201%20%C3%A9poca%20%22tarde%22%20en%20una%20ResNet%20y%205%20%C3%A9pocas%20%22tarde%22%20en%20un%20ViT%2C%20o%20conviene%20medirlo%20en%20fracci%C3%B3n%20del%20entrenamiento%20(1%2F30%20contra%205%2F100)%3F%20%C2%BFCon%20qu%C3%A9%20unidad%20se%20compara%20el%20%24k%24%20entre%20arquitecturas%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Sobre%20qu%C3%A9%20es%20un%20ticket.**%0A%20%20%20%204.%20Que%20el%20control%20aleatorio%20(misma%20m%C3%A1scara%2C%20pesos%20nuevos)%20falle%20por%20mucho%20indica%20que%20no%20es%20solo%20la%20estructura.%20%C2%BFQu%C3%A9%20parte%20la%20aporta%20la%20inicializaci%C3%B3n%20exacta%20y%20qu%C3%A9%20parte%20la%20*escala*%20de%20los%20pesos%20que%20sobrevivieron%3F%20*(Reinicializar%20con%20los%20mismos%20valores%20permutados%20por%20capa.)*%0A%20%20%20%205.%20En%20el%20ViT%20largo%20el%20ticket%20supera%20a%20la%20red%20densa%20con%20~12%25%20de%20los%20pesos.%20%C2%BFEs%20un%20efecto%20de%20regularizaci%C3%B3n%20por%20poda%20o%20un%20baseline%20todav%C3%ADa%20mejorable%3F%20*(M%C3%A1s%20%C3%A9pocas%20o%20m%C3%A1s%20aumento%20al%20denso%3B%20varias%20semillas.)*%0A%20%20%20%206.%20En%2004%20el%20ticket%20superaba%20al%20denso%20(subentrenado)%20y%20en%2005%20tambi%C3%A9n%20(mejor%20entrenado)%2C%20pero%20%5B5%5D%20dice%20que%20estos%20tickets%20son%20dif%C3%ADciles%20en%20ViTs.%20%C2%BFQu%C3%A9%20condiciones%20del%20recipe%20(aumento%20de%20datos%2C%20tama%C3%B1o%20del%20modelo%2C%20poda%20global)%20explican%20la%20diferencia%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Sobre%20la%20CNN%20y%20la%20poda%20por%20capa.**%0A%20%20%20%207.%20El%20colapso%20a%2010.7%25%20se%20repiti%C3%B3%20y%20coincide%20con%20filtros%20y%20neuronas%20completamente%20vac%C3%ADos.%20%C2%BFSer%C3%ADa%20evitable%20con%20poda%20global%2C%20que%20puede%20podar%20menos%20las%20capas%20peque%C3%B1as%3F%20*(Respondida%20por%2002b%3A%20s%C3%AD%2C%20a%2010.7%25%20el%20ticket%20pasa%20de%2053.0%25%20a%2075.7%25%2C%20sin%20filtros%20ni%20neuronas%20vac%C3%ADos.%20Queda%20abierto%20si%20es%20la%20poda%20global%20en%20s%C3%AD%20o%20simplemente%20que%20la%20primera%20conv%20conserve%20m%C3%A1s%20pesos%3B%20se%20separar%C3%ADa%20fijando%20un%20m%C3%ADnimo%20por%20capa%20en%20la%20poda%20por%20capa.)*%0A%20%20%20%208.%20%C2%BFUna%20capa%20con%207%20de%2064%20filtros%20vac%C3%ADos%20es%20un%20problema%20de%20capacidad%20o%20solo%20desperdicio%20de%20pesos%3F%20*(Podar%20manteniendo%20un%20m%C3%ADnimo%20por%20filtro.)*%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Sobre%20las%20m%C3%A1scaras.**%0A%20%20%20%209.%20%C2%BFPor%20qu%C3%A9%20la%20atenci%C3%B3n%20del%20control%20aleatorio%20se%20concentra%20abajo%20si%20comparte%20la%20m%C3%A1scara%20con%20el%20ticket%3F%20%C2%BFQu%C3%A9%20papel%20juega%20la%20inicializaci%C3%B3n%20en%20d%C3%B3nde%20%22mira%22%20la%20red%3F%0A%20%20%20%2010.%20%C2%BFQu%C3%A9%20tanto%20se%20parecen%20las%20m%C3%A1scaras%20del%20ticket%20y%20del%20rewinding%20(IoU%2C%20ver%2006)%3F%20Si%20se%20parecen%20poco%20pero%20ambos%20funcionan%2C%20%C2%BFhay%20muchos%20tickets%20distintos%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Sobre%20la%20metodolog%C3%ADa.**%0A%20%20%20%2011.%20Con%20una%20sola%20semilla%20y%20~10%2C000%20im%C3%A1genes%20de%20prueba%2C%20%C2%BFqu%C3%A9%20diferencias%20son%20cre%C3%ADbles%3F%20(Un%20intervalo%20binomial%20del%2095%25%20sobre%20una%20accuracy%20de%20~88%25%20mide%20%C2%B10.6%20puntos%3B%20las%20diferencias%20entre%20ticket%20y%20aleatorio%20de%205-9%20puntos%20lo%20superan%2C%20pero%20la%20de%20ticket%20contra%20denso%20a%207.5%25%20no.)%0A%20%20%20%2012.%20%C2%BFC%C3%B3mo%20afecta%20que%20la%20poda%20est%C3%A9%20global%20en%20unos%20modelos%20y%20por%20capa%20en%20otros%20a%20la%20comparaci%C3%B3n%20entre%20arquitecturas%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%208.1%20Borradores%20de%20respuesta%0A%20%20%20%20Respuestas%20tentativas%2C%20con%20lo%20que%20los%20datos%20permiten%20decir.%20Est%C3%A1n%20pensadas%20como%20punto%20de%20partida%20para%20reescribir.%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20**Arquitectura%20o%20estabilidad%20del%20arranque.**%20Los%20datos%20no%20separan%20las%20dos.%20Lo%20que%20se%20observa%3A%20ResNet%20(lr%200.1%2C%20sin%20warmup)%20necesita%20rewinding%3B%20el%20ViT%20(con%20warmup)%20no%20lo%20necesita%20a%20%E2%89%A512%25%20y%20s%C3%AD%20lo%20aprovecha%20por%20debajo%20de%20~8%25.%20Es%20compatible%20con%20que%20el%20warmup%20haga%20el%20trabajo%20del%20rewinding%2C%20pero%20tambi%C3%A9n%20con%20que%20el%20ViT%20sea%20m%C3%A1s%20tolerante.%20Confundidos%3A%20optimizador%20(SGD%20vs.%20AdamW)%2C%20datos%2C%20tasa%20de%20poda.%20Se%20resolver%C3%ADa%20repitiendo%20con%20warmup%2Fsin%20warmup.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20**El%20punto%20de%20rewind%20depende%20del%20nivel%20de%20poda.**%20Los%20datos%20del%20ViT%20largo%20lo%20sugieren%20(sin%20efecto%20a%20%E2%89%A512%25%2C%20%2B3.4%20puntos%20a%207.5%25)%2C%20pero%20solo%20hay%20un%20punto%20de%20rewind%20(%C3%A9poca%205)%20y%20una%20semilla.%20Es%20una%20pista%2C%20no%20una%20conclusi%C3%B3n.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20**Unidad%20del%20punto%20de%20rewind.**%20Medido%20en%20fracci%C3%B3n%20del%20entrenamiento%2C%201%20%C3%A9poca%20de%2077%20(1.3%25)%20en%20la%20ResNet%20y%205%20de%20100%20(5%25)%20en%20el%20ViT%20son%20del%20mismo%20orden.%20Medido%20en%20iteraciones%3A%20391%20contra%20~1%2C950.%20No%20hay%20una%20unidad%20natural%3B%20lo%20razonable%20es%20reportar%20las%20tres%20(%C3%A9pocas%2C%20iteraciones%2C%20fracci%C3%B3n)%20y%20barrer%20%24k%24.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20**Estructura%20vs.%20valores.**%20El%20control%20aleatorio%20(misma%20m%C3%A1scara)%20pierde%205-9%20puntos%20en%20el%20ViT%20largo%20y%20~2%20en%20el%20MLP%2C%20as%C3%AD%20que%20la%20estructura%20sola%20no%20basta.%20Falta%20separar%20*qu%C3%A9*%20de%20los%20valores%20iniciales%20importa%3A%20los%20valores%20exactos%20o%20su%20escala.%20Reinicializar%20permutando%20los%20valores%20del%20ticket%20dentro%20de%20cada%20capa%20mantendr%C3%ADa%20la%20escala%20y%20romper%C3%ADa%20la%20asignaci%C3%B3n.%0A%20%20%20%205.%20**Ticket%20%3E%20denso%20en%20el%20ViT.**%20El%20denso%20de%20100%20%C3%A9pocas%20llega%20a%2086.0%25%20y%20el%20ticket%20a%2089.0%25%20con%2027.5%25%20de%20los%20pesos%2C%20as%C3%AD%20que%20no%20es%20solo%20un%20baseline%20d%C3%A9bil.%20Hip%C3%B3tesis%20restante%3A%20la%20poda%20act%C3%BAa%20como%20regularizador%20(menos%20par%C3%A1metros%2C%20menos%20sobreajuste)%3B%20apoya%20que%20hay%20brecha%20entrenamiento-prueba.%20Se%20probar%C3%ADa%20con%20m%C3%A1s%20aumento%20de%20datos%20al%20denso%20o%20con%20varias%20semillas.%0A%20%20%20%206.%20**Tickets%20en%20ViT%20seg%C3%BAn%20%5B5%5D.**%20%5B5%5D%20reporta%20que%20los%20tickets%20a%20nivel%20de%20peso%20son%20dif%C3%ADciles%20de%20encontrar%20en%20ViTs%3B%20aqu%C3%AD%20el%20ViT%20es%20peque%C3%B1o%20(1.8M%20pesos)%2C%20con%20aumento%20de%20datos%20fuerte%20y%20poda%20global.%20No%20se%20pueden%20separar%20esos%20factores%20con%20los%20datos%3B%20la%20diferencia%20podr%C3%ADa%20ser%20de%20tama%C3%B1o%20de%20modelo%20o%20de%20receta%2C%20y%20hay%20que%20presentarlo%20con%20reserva.%0A%20%20%20%207.%20**Poda%20global%20y%20CNN.**%20Respondida%3A%20con%20poda%20global%20el%20ticket%20a%2010.7%25%20pasa%20de%2053.0%25%20a%2075.7%25%2C%20y%20las%20m%C3%A1scaras%20no%20tienen%20filtros%20ni%20neuronas%20vac%C3%ADos.%20Es%20evidencia%20de%20que%20el%20colapso%20era%20por%20la%20poda%20por%20capa%2C%20no%20por%20la%20CNN%3B%20no%20separa%20%22poda%20global%22%20de%20%22cada%20capa%20conserva%20m%C3%A1s%20pesos%22%20(se%20har%C3%ADa%20con%20un%20m%C3%ADnimo%20por%20capa).%0A%20%20%20%208.%20**Filtros%20vac%C3%ADos.**%207%20de%2064%20filtros%20vac%C3%ADos%20en%20la%20primera%20convoluci%C3%B3n%20es%20capacidad%20perdida%20(esas%20salidas%20son%20constantes)%2C%20y%20se%20suma%20a%20que%20102%20de%20las%20256%20neuronas%20ocultas%20no%20llegan%20a%20la%20salida.%20Con%2010.7%25%20de%20los%20pesos%20totales%20esta%20red%20perd%C3%ADa%20capacidad%20real%2C%20no%20solo%20pesos%20redundantes.%20Probar%20con%20un%20m%C3%ADnimo%20de%20pesos%20por%20filtro%20lo%20confirmar%C3%ADa.%0A%20%20%20%209.%20**Atenci%C3%B3n%20del%20control%20aleatorio.**%20Mismo%20patr%C3%B3n%20de%20conexiones%2C%20otra%20inicializaci%C3%B3n%2C%20otro%20lugar%20donde%20mira%20la%20red%3A%20la%20inicializaci%C3%B3n%20influye%20en%20qu%C3%A9%20soluciones%20encuentra%20el%20entrenamiento%2C%20no%20solo%20la%20estructura.%20Es%20una%20observaci%C3%B3n%20sobre%205%20im%C3%A1genes%20de%20una%20corrida.%0A%20%20%20%2010.%20**Ticket%20vs.%20rewinding.**%20Comparar%20el%20IoU%20de%2006%20contra%20el%20IoU%20esperado%20entre%20dos%20m%C3%A1scaras%20al%20azar%20de%20la%20misma%20densidad.%20Si%20es%20claramente%20mayor%2C%20ambos%20m%C3%A9todos%20redescubren%20parte%20de%20la%20misma%20estructura%3B%20si%20es%20bajo%20y%20ambos%20funcionan%2C%20hay%20muchos%20tickets%20distintos.%0A%20%20%20%2011.%20**Qu%C3%A9%20diferencias%20son%20cre%C3%ADbles.**%20El%20intervalo%20binomial%20del%2095%25%20con%2010%2C000%20im%C3%A1genes%20y%20~88%25%20es%20%C2%B10.6%20puntos.%20Ticket%20vs.%20aleatorio%20(5-9%20puntos)%2C%20ticket%20vs.%20denso%20con%2027.5%25%20de%20los%20pesos%20(%2B3%20puntos)%20y%20colapso%20de%20la%20CNN%20(%E2%88%928%20puntos)%20superan%20ese%20intervalo%3B%20ticket%20vs.%20denso%20con%207.5%25%20de%20los%20pesos%20no.%20Aun%20as%C3%AD%20el%20ruido%20entre%20corridas%20(semilla)%20no%20se%20midi%C3%B3%20y%20puede%20ser%20mayor%20que%20el%20binomial.%0A%20%20%20%2012.%20**Poda%20global%20vs.%20por%20capa%20entre%20arquitecturas.**%20El%20resultado%20de%20la%20CNN%20muestra%20que%20no%20es%20un%20detalle%3A%20cambia%20el%20resultado.%20Comparar%20el%20MLP%20(por%20capa)%20con%20el%20ViT%20(global)%20mezcla%20arquitectura%20con%20tipo%20de%20poda.%20Lo%20limpio%20ser%C3%ADa%20repetir%20cada%20arquitectura%20con%20ambos%20tipos%20de%20poda.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%209.%20Conclusiones%20y%20trabajo%20futuro%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Se%20encontraron%20winning%20tickets%20en%20el%20MLP%2C%20la%20CNN%20y%20el%20ViT%20(tambi%C3%A9n%20con%20100%20%C3%A9pocas%20y%20mejor%20baseline)%3B%20en%20la%20ResNet%20solo%20con%20rewinding.%20El%20colapso%20del%20ticket%20de%20la%20CNN%20a%2010.7%25%20se%20debi%C3%B3%20a%20la%20poda%20por%20capa%3A%20con%20poda%20global%20desaparece%20(75.7%25%20contra%2053.0%25).%0A%20%20%20%202.%20Cu%C3%A1nto%20hay%20que%20rebobinar%20parece%20depender%20de%20la%20arquitectura%20y%20del%20recipe%20de%20entrenamiento%2C%20pero%20con%20los%20datos%20actuales%20no%20se%20puede%20separar%20un%20efecto%20del%20otro.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Trabajo%20futuro%3A%20barrido%20del%20punto%20de%20rewind%20%24k%24%20en%20las%20cuatro%20arquitecturas%20con%20varias%20semillas%3B%20repetir%20el%20ViT%20con%20y%20sin%20warmup%3B%20transferencia%20de%20tickets%20entre%20datasets.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Referencias%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Frankle%20%26%20Carbin%2C%20*The%20Lottery%20Ticket%20Hypothesis%3A%20Finding%20Sparse%2C%20Trainable%20Neural%20Networks*%2C%20ICLR%202019.%20https%3A%2F%2Farxiv.org%2Fabs%2F1803.03635%0A%20%20%20%202.%20Frankle%2C%20Dziugaite%2C%20Roy%20%26%20Carbin%2C%20*Stabilizing%20the%20Lottery%20Ticket%20Hypothesis*%2C%202019.%20https%3A%2F%2Farxiv.org%2Fabs%2F1903.01611%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Renda%2C%20Frankle%20%26%20Carbin%2C%20*Comparing%20Rewinding%20and%20Fine-tuning%20in%20Neural%20Network%20Pruning*%2C%20ICLR%202020.%20https%3A%2F%2Farxiv.org%2Fabs%2F2003.02389%0A%20%20%20%204.%20Touvron%20et%20al.%2C%20*Training%20data-efficient%20image%20transformers%20%26%20distillation%20through%20attention*%20(DeiT)%2C%20ICML%202021.%20https%3A%2F%2Farxiv.org%2Fabs%2F2012.12877%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Shen%2C%20Kong%2C%20Qin%2C%20Dong%2C%20Yuan%2C%20Meng%2C%20Tang%2C%20Ma%20%26%20Wang%2C%20*Data%20Level%20Lottery%20Ticket%20Hypothesis%20for%20Vision%20Transformers*%2C%20IJCAI%202023.%20https%3A%2F%2Farxiv.org%2Fabs%2F2211.01484%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0Aif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%22__main__%22%3A%0A%20%20%20%20app.run()%0A
